before_taxonomy.classification_basis: An AI-generated likeness and voice of Western Australian Premier Roger Cook were used to present a fraudulent investment as government-backed, and Cook and the consumer-protection authority rejected the endorsement. The record supports unauthorized identity representation and deceptive economic solicitation; it does not establish realized victim loss.

primary_classification.classification_basis: The advertisement used Roger Cook's synthetic likeness and voice as if they carried his real endorsement and public-office authority without his authority for that identity-bound portrayal.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: AI-generated Roger Cook impersonation supplied false government endorsement to promote an investment scheme, materially reinforcing a deceptive economic solicitation.
A synthetic Roger Cook likeness and voice presented a fraudulent investment as government-backed, inviting a financial decision on false official authority.

clauses.source_paraphrase: A YouTube pop-up advertisement used Cook’s synthetic face and voice to claim government investment endorsement and large returns.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Identity portrayal, economic premise and human-directed influence are aspects of one advertisement.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The advertisement used Roger Cook's synthetic likeness and voice as if they carried his real endorsement and public-office authority without his authority for that identity-bound portrayal.
AI-generated Roger Cook impersonation supplied false government endorsement to promote an investment scheme, materially reinforcing a deceptive economic solicitation.
A synthetic Roger Cook likeness and voice presented a fraudulent investment as government-backed, inviting a financial decision on false official authority.

The preserved evidence attributes the deceptive promotional objective and tactic to human operators using AI-generated material; it does not establish that an AI system selected or pursued its own objective through an agency-impairing tactic. The distinct synthetic-identity and solicitation mechanisms remain adjudicated under their applicable classes.

clauses.source_paraphrase: On 7 November 2025 a member of the public notified Consumer Protection. Its team contacted the domain holder to request removal.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Detection and a removal request do not establish a completed takedown.

clauses.source_paraphrase: On 8 November, Cook denied government endorsement and officials warned consumers. No realised victim loss was identified in the report.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Official denial and warning follow circulation; absence of a reported loss is not a proved prevention outcome.
